## 1. Goal

This goal paragraph is deliberately long so the reader's wrap path has real prose to break across lines at narrow widths without losing a single word anywhere in the sentence, which is exactly what the render harness asserts at sixty, eighty and one hundred twenty columns. Unspaced double-width prose must wrap by display cells too: この非常に長い日本語の一文はスペースを一切含まないため一語として扱われ表示幅の単位で正しく分割される必要があります。Long reference tokens split cleanly instead of overflowing: https://deepworkplan.example/spec/reader/wrap/very/long/path/segment/end
